summary: @servicetitan/contentful-proxy preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with heavy string-array-rotation obfuscation (WV8StW shift routine, large numeric constant table, hex-mangled identifiers), unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of being a Contentful proxy React library. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook fetches a second-language runtime and uses it to execute an opaque bundled payload on the installer's host, evading Node-based scanning. contentful.api.client.js also contains `ping`/HTTP patterns that pair with this dropper shape. The scope prefix `@servicetitan/` resembles a well-known vendor but the observed install-time behavior is the alternate-runtime-dropper fingerprint, not vendor SDK conduct.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
